title: Transverse wave
content: If the displacements of particles of the medium are perpendicular to the direction of the wave, such a wave is called a transverse wave[cite: 1].

title: Longitudinal wave
content: If the displacements of particles of medium are parallel to the direction of the waves, such a wave is called a longitudinal wave[cite: 1].

title: Wavelength
content: The distance between any two consecutive wave crests (or) two consecutive wave troughs is called wavelength[cite: 1].

title: Frequency
content: The number of complete waves passing a point per second is called frequency of waves[cite: 1].

title: Period
content: The time taken by the wave to travel the distance between any two consecutive wave crests (or) the time required for one complete vibration is called period of a wave[cite: 1].

title: Amplitude
content: The amplitude of a wave is the maximum value of displacement of vibrating element[cite: 1].

title: Wavefront
content: The surface that joins all the points of same phase is called wavefront[cite: 1].
